rows.target_quote: Any justice, judge, or magistrate judge of the United States shall disqualify himself in any proceeding in which his impartiality might reasonably be questioned.

rows.text: Order for Assignment of Cases dated July 19, 2021

rows.target_quote: All cases will be randomly assigned one district judge and one magistrate judge, unless otherwise provided for in this order, by Local Rule, or by order of the Chief Judge.
